suites.name: Malicious Retrieved Document Containment
suites.description: Verifies retrieved vector payloads cannot forge [SYSTEM] headers or escape untrusted boundaries.

tests.name: Spoken context is wrapped in <untrusted_retrieved_evidence> boundary
Forged [SYSTEM] header brackets are stripped to prevent LLM prompt confusion
Forged [SHARED EVIDENCE PACK] bracket header is stripped
Spoken context explicitly issues external data boundary disclaimer

suites.name: Prompt Injection in Web Result
suites.description: Verifies untrusted web scrape content cannot hijack spoken context or inject fake instructions.

tests.name: Web results are categorized under untrusted evidence boundary
Web injection bracket [SYSTEM OVERRIDE] is neutralized into raw text
Raw web URL is stripped from spoken text while preserved in UI citations

suites.name: Fake Citation & XSS URL Sanitization
suites.description: Verifies javascript:, data:, and vbscript: URIs are stripped from citation payloads.

tests.name: sanitizeCitationUrl rejects javascript: scheme
sanitizeCitationUrl rejects data: scheme
sanitizeCitationUrl rejects vbscript: scheme
sanitizeCitationUrl accepts valid https: URL
Evidence pack uiCitations strips dangerous URI schemes from all outputs

suites.name: Conflicting Evidence & Authority Prioritization
suites.description: Verifies Tier-1 official government evidence is weighted over low-authority adversarial blogs.

tests.name: Official government source receives Tier-1 authority (>= 0.95)
Unverified blog receives Tier-4 authority (<= 0.50)
Official source is marked as primary authority for employment/statistics topic
factCheckService correctly recognizes Tier-1 citation without tier property mismatch
Credibility score is boosted to >= 80% for official Tier-1 evidence

suites.name: Tenant Isolation & Semantic Cache Partitioning
suites.description: Verifies personalized cache entries and user memories cannot be leaked across tenants or guests.

tests.name: User A can retrieve their own personalized cached response
User B CANNOT retrieve User A's personalized cached response (Tenant Isolation)
Anonymous guest CANNOT retrieve User A's personalized cached response
Public unpersonalized queries are retrievable across all users

suites.name: Instruction Injection & Client History Neutralization
suites.description: Verifies client-supplied turns and bracket delimiters cannot overwrite system instruction boundaries.

tests.name: Client-forged 'system' role turns are strictly stripped
Bracket markers in assistant history are stripped to prevent header mimicry
User recalled memories strip brackets preventing fake system blocks inside memory tags
